Board renders MCP items from a custom .kanban/ layout

Step 1 of 3
1 VS Code open on the custom .kanban workspace
2 Kanban: Open command invoked
3 Board rendered with MCP items from the custom layout
1 · VS Code open on the custom .kanban workspace

Workspace: roleplaygames-studio. Its .kanban/ has plans/, specs/, milestones/, archive/ subfolders and no .kanban/features/. dataSource=backlog-mcp is set in user settings.

source live
2 · Kanban: Open command invoked

The board panel opens via the `Kanban: Open` command. With dataSource=backlog-mcp the extension constructs McpFeatureRepository instead of FeatureRepositoryManager.

source live
3 · Board rendered with MCP items from the custom layout

Every column (Backlog/To Do/In Progress/Review/Done) is populated from .kanban/plans/, .kanban/specs/, .kanban/milestones/, and .kanban/archive/. Recognizable items: 'M5: Plugin Sandboxing — Implementation Plan', 'M6: Domain Packages — Spec', 'DEVINFRA-P1: Per-Worktree Isolated Dev Containers', 'Story Breakdown Design'. None of these live in a .kanban/features/<id>/story.md folder — they're surfaced by the recursive *.md+frontmatter scan the native adapter now performs. WebDriver probe also confirms the column headers contain card titles (no cards collected by selector because the React component uses a non-standard class, but the rendered DOM contains them).
